In anticipation of Oppenheimer release, I finished reading the book it is adapted from- American Prometheus: The Triumph and Tragedy of J Robert Oppenheimer

Here’s a top line synopsis of the stuff to know before you see the movie

author_info.bio: I write dumb and bad essays on politics and culture from my cramped NYC studio apartment.
author_info.name: Dan Frank

items.post_caption_text:
The first 1/3 of the book is typical backstory/exposition about an awkward and eccentric (if brilliant) Oppie who, during adolescence struggles to find his place in the world outside of the Upper West Side Jewish neighborhood community that he grew up in. 

He excels in physics and eventually achieves a place as one of the top minds in theoretical physics, during the golden era of this field in the first half of the 20th century
